nodes.label: Application / AI client
nodes.notes: Application or AI consumer of the custom gateway. The external opaque application user key must be trusted and bound server-side through the RLS request.

MCP gateway
Binds trusted app user key
nodes.notes: Implemented ISV-built hosted custom MCP server provides schema retrieval, scoped value search and DAX execution with trusted application-user-key binding. Reuses the official open-source MCP C# SDK for server transport and the native IQ client; neither forks native Fabric IQ MCP nor invents the protocol. Custom application-aware behavior is not limited to a single function.

Delegated metadata account
nodes.notes: Only native schema retrieval is used, through delegated OAuth with a metadata account. Native query execution and value search are not used. Native Fabric IQ MCP does not accept service-principal/app-only authentication.

nodes.label:

Power BI REST + model RLS
Data + reports
Service principal
nodes.notes: Custom data tools use Power BI REST executeDaxQueries with a service principal; the request accepts query, roles and customData, and dynamic model RLS can evaluate CUSTOMDATA(). A role-bearing service principal requires workspace Admin. Report embedding uses GenerateToken with effective identity fields username, roles, datasets and customData, bound to the same trusted opaque application user key and model RLS. This reuses, rather than rebuilds, Power BI authorization.
